name: Dead Man's Hand
tagline: The house always wins. Tonight, the house killed.
description: High rollers, showgirls and the mob's accountant, all at one high-stakes poker table. When the casino owner collapses over a royal flush, everyone at the table is holding a motive.
artStyle: 1960s Vegas neon signage, green felt tables, retro pulp illustration
